takes.title: Tucked twisting jump
takes.actionDescription: The performer winds up with the arms, jumps into a sideways twist with the knees folded, then straightens and steps out of the landing.

takes.title: Twisting jump into hand contact
takes.actionDescription: The performer steps into a turning jump, folds forward with one leg extending behind, then bends the knees and comes upright.

takes.title: Upright breakdance steps
takes.actionDescription: The performer links crossing steps, changes of facing, side leans, and arm accents before coming back to a relaxed stance.

takes.title: Breakdance footwork into one-hand inversion
takes.actionDescription: The performer alternates quick upright footwork with low crouches and finishes the phrase with one hand down and one leg lifted vertically.

takes.title: Handstand with scissoring kicks
takes.actionDescription: The performer puts both hands down, kicks into a handstand, changes the leg split overhead several times, and lowers the feet to stand.

takes.title: High kick and kick flip
takes.actionDescription: The performer bends to prepare, drives one leg high through a turning kick, lands in a deep squat, and stands again.

takes.title: Kick flip with low recovery
takes.actionDescription: The performer builds up to a turning kick, drops into a wide low landing, then steps out with both arms extended for balance.

takes.title: Helicopter floor sweep
takes.actionDescription: The performer drops from standing to a low hand-supported position, sweeps an extended leg around near the floor, and finishes with both hands near the ground.

takes.title: Motorcycle stance
takes.actionDescription: The performer holds a staggered stance with bent knees and the elbows lifted, keeping both fists forward as if holding handlebars.

takes.title: Inverted breakdance finish
takes.actionDescription: The take opens upside down on the hands. The performer folds and extends the legs through low supports, then pushes off the floor and stands.

takes.title: Upright footwork into crouch
takes.actionDescription: The performer takes light crossing and turning steps, bends forward through the middle of the phrase, and drops into a low hand-supported finish.

takes.title: Long breakdance phrase with inversions
takes.actionDescription: The performer begins with upright steps and arm accents, then moves through crouches, hand-supported rotations, and an inversion before rising again.

takes.title: Breakdance phrase with floor recovery
takes.actionDescription: The performer walks into a low setup, kicks up onto the hands, rotates through several low supports with long leg reaches, and returns to standing.

takes.title: Breakdance with flips and freezes
takes.actionDescription: The performer weaves upright steps and kicks into low floor positions, flips, and a one-hand balance, then rises with the feet apart.

takes.title: Twisting floor sequence with fall
takes.actionDescription: The performer crouches, kicks the legs around through hand-supported positions, drops back toward the floor, and regains an upright stance.
